findings.failure_scenario: migrate apply --local-only-secrets copies every plan file and then dies at the bridge post-rename fail point (marker still legacy, secret-pattern files already in projects/<id>/). The retry builds a plan whose units are skipped-equal because the workspace digests match, the bridge answers skipped-equal, and _record_local_only ignores any row whose action is not copied or imported-copy. The files stay in the work tree with no local-only.json row and no exclude line. doctor --publish-safety and sync --commit then flag them as PS-SECRET and refuse the commit; a further apply is already migrated or skipped-equal and does not repair the index. Size-based local-only files self-heal on that scan; secret-pattern files do not, because publish-safety still treats the content as a block.

findings.failure_scenario: A plans tree contains .env or server.pem and the user already passed --local-only-secrets. plan and apply still exit 1 with MIGRATION_BLOCKED_SECRET, and the message tells them to repeat with --local-only-secrets. That command is the one they just ran; name-based secrets stay blockers, so the hint does not change the outcome.
